messages.text: Jasper says Miles and Theo can both make the 22nd if you are still holding that evening.
Good. I blocked the same 7 to 10 window and will send the link once I finish the map cleanup.
Nora also asked whether her character can keep the ridiculous lantern. I told her I am not the judge.
The lantern survives if they remember what it does. I need a couple quiet writing blocks before then.
Mom found the blue folder from 2019 again. She says Robert's discharge papers and the service booklet are mixed together.
Tell her not to reread it tonight. I'll stop by after Joe Bean tomorrow and put it back in the file box.
Mom found a box labeled 2014-2020 Rochester office in her basement. Do you want it before she starts reorganizing again?
Yes. If it has the old routing diagrams and random-seed notebooks, I should shred most of it myself.
Also Dana texted me about Miriam's new address. Syracuse return label, very formal of course.
Noted. Also saw a 2021 Reston folder in there. I did not open it.
That tracks. I should answer Dana politely and ask how Miriam is without making it weird.
Good. That folder can stay closed until I am feeling less like checking job boards for bad reasons.
I found your little brown case under the Sunday newspaper stack. It was exactly where you said it would not be.
Naturally. Please leave it by the door before I have to hold the pot roast recipe at arm's length again.
It is by the door. Also, that recipe card is too small for anyone with dignity.
Dignity and I are in active negotiations.
hey you. canal walk thursday still okay, or is your left side doing that thing again?
Short walk is okay. No heroic Watkins Glen rehearsal. Wei has me at 4:30 in the South Wedge first.
good. i'll meet you after and bring the flatter shoes.
Appreciated. The 2021 trail incident gets one vote, not two.
hey you. is saturday still your gorge thing with tom and rashida?
Yes, if the ice isn't ridiculous. They're lobbying for the place with all the stone stairs again.
the dramatic water-and-stairs place?
Exactly. I promised them I'd check the south entrance notice before we commit.
hey you. did you ever find the receipt from that 53rd street room with the floor-to-ceiling projections?
Found it. Also found the Maine notebook with the little brass-stamp business cards tucked inside.
keep both. i want to see the brass cards, and the japan list you mentioned.
The list is half Kamo River coffee counters, half wildly impractical desert packing tabs.
Joe Bean at 9 still works. Same table if the window outlet is open?
Yes. I need the outlet after last night's render. Leaving the two big screens asleep and hoping Fermi doesn't restart the patch cables while I'm gone.
Noted. Bring the figure draft, not the whole command center.
Agreed. The command center stays in the back room with the blinking knobs and the plant vandal.
Declan mailed Mom another packet of clippings. One was about the old Local 22 hall breakfast and one was a box score he circled in red pen.
That is extremely him. Was the box score from Innovative Field or the arena?
Jasper's debate coach forwarded that Rochester panel you mentioned. The one about phone lockers and the three apps the kids all use.
Yes. I am trying to ask one question without sounding like someone's uncle yelling at a router.
Arena. Also Siobhan sent me the same meme she sent you, apparently. The one with the stretcher and the goalie mask.
She knows her audience. Tell Mom I will take the clippings Sunday if she wants the refrigerator cleared.
Ask about the district buying software that watches student searches. That part made me twitch.
That and why the same few companies get to set the terms for every school, every kid, every parent. I can keep it to two minutes.
hey you. still on for dinner friday?
Yes. I grabbed black cod from Palmers and the white miso is already behaving itself in the bowl.
i can bring bowls from the studio if you want. the green glaze ones.
Perfect. I will do scallions and the basil from the window box, and make the yellow ginger pot after.
Sent the school-board questionnaire. Reyes is good on the waiting-period paperwork and the court-order removal piece. Vague on wages.
I saw that. The paperwork-before-sale answer matters more to me than whether she says the correct big slogan.
Her labor section only says '$15 where possible.' That is mushy.
Agreed. If it does not move with rent and groceries, Rochester and Brooklyn are being pretended into the same spreadsheet.
Saturday after Joe Bean: Kilbourn has a 1 p.m. student program. No tickets listed. Noted.
That works. If we sit balcony-left I can still make the 3:15 thing on University.
Balcony-left is your old camera-room strategy, apparently. You do this in every building with staircases and glass cases.
Blame the weekend folders Mom kept from the big mansion and the toy grocery aisles. I was trained early.
Hey. You still coming to rehearsal, or did the Tuesday Dr. Liu slot scramble the whole week?
Call is 7:10. You bringing the tiny 5 mg square or trusting the first scene to be merciful?
Tiny square stays sealed unless my brain starts doing taxes backstage. Also no yellow-label pour before MuCCC.
Coming. I moved the pickup to the morning and did the Liu call from the car like a ridiculous adult.
Good. Last Thursday you were sharper with seltzer anyway. Bring the receipt book?
Good. Also please do not repeat last summer's urgent-care tour over a tight shirt and bad coffee.
Receipt book, mints, and the dead pen from the 2022 pocket-device era is still dead.
Noted. If my sternum gets theatrical, I will drink water and wait ten minutes before Googling my obituary.
Did you send Marsha the 1099 packet yet? I am making my own list before I forget everything.
Not yet. Vanguard posted the VTI/VXUS pages, and Ally is easy. I still need to download the old-job rollover form.
Please do it before Sunday. Also, for July flights, I am assuming your return still lands in the high-forties once the extra forms are counted?
That is the rough neighborhood. I will let Marsha make the real number less hand-wavy.
Mom said you walked back from the church lot after that tiny county thing with music in both ears. Please tell me you at least did the front-hall checklist.
I did the latch this time. And it was three blocks, Cath.
Three blocks is still three blocks. Also, I admire your ability to treat a county judge line like Opening Day.
There was no line. In and out, same folding tables by the basement stairs.
Are you still hauling the RMSC light-box kit tomorrow, or did Jenna finally find you a second set?
Still hauling it. Lincoln Branch at 10, then I have to rebuild the color-gradient deck before Tuesday's group.
I can stop by for the first hour if you want another pair of hands. Noted: I will not touch the projector settings.
Deal. If you see me forgetting the receipt envelope, tackle me politely.
Jasper says the graph you sent actually ran after he changed the path. He wants to know why you used R for the plot and MATLAB for the matrix part.
Because I enjoy making teenagers ask exactly that question. Tell him the short answer is: each tool was less annoying for a different piece.
He also tried to send you a TikTok explanation and Nora said, 'Uncle Julio will never see that.' Accurate?
Accurate. Screenshot or carrier pigeon. Also I burned my morning 20 on feeds already, so I am going back to the charcoal mess.
Can you eyeball the front step tomorrow before you go in? She told me it was fine, which means it was absolutely not fine.
I will bring the shovel and perform the ceremonial inspection.
Also please tell Eleanor that one photo of the pan is enough. She has sent me three already.
The 78-year-old roast-content director cannot be stopped, but I will try.
Did the town bill come out of your account yet? I remember it usually lands early in March.
Yes. $2,100 and change, which is why the hallway plaster is waiting one more week.
I found the Strong envelope from last October in the drawer with your father's records. Do you want it Sunday?
Yes, thanks. I want to compare it with the portal reminder so I don't invent a date.
Please do not stand on that old ladder alone. Your father kept it too long.
Good. And please ask your doctor before listening to that woman from my church who keeps sending videos.
I am only measuring today. Same west wall that has been half-behaved since the Obama years.
Already planning to. CDC page first, Dr. Levine second, church-video channel never.
hey you. canal towpath after my noon studio check?
Yes. I need actual sky before I become furniture.
bring gloves. also, no showing me houses in Maine over lunch.
Fine. One bowl of soup, zero tabs, one walk.
hey you. kiln is cooling slowly, so i can come by around 8 if that still works.
8 works. I have to reconcile the little pile of Fringe slips first, then I want to show you the patch that turns the bell hit into that shimmery wash.
hey you. still on for dinner after the studio?
Yes. Black cod, barley, greens, miso glaze. I am resisting the butter-and-cheddar version my soul wants.
bring me in after the number boxes stop making you swear.
The number boxes and the bank import are both currently rude.
that sounds better anyway. do you need me to bring anything?
No, I already did Wegmans and Abundance. The food sheet says $312 so far this month, so I am pretending that is discipline. Also saved room for Beth's first sourdough drop in May.
hey you. send me the blue-green one when it dries? the lake edge looked less fussy in person.
It is still tacky, but the second pass made the west shore read better. I also made the moving version loop at 12 seconds.
the kiln gods approve of 12 seconds. did you keep the little pulsing line from the patch cables?
Yes. The cable photo is just hidden enough that nobody will know why the line wiggles that way.
Hey. Did you mail the thank-you note to the county people, or is it still sitting under the coffee cup like performance art?
Mailed. Also scanned the receipt packet. Tiny checks still require weirdly adult paperwork.
Good. Now take the three-month monster and make it smaller before it eats June too.
I am cutting the opening pages first. Less throat-clearing, more wave-collapse on page 2.
Hey. Are you still doing the Kaplan thing Monday, or did the monthly blue-card bill eat that again?
Moved it to a phone estimate review. The left molar is not getting the deluxe treatment while Excellus is taking five hundred plus.
Your mouth has become a budget committee. Very on brand, very upsetting.
Budget committee voted to chew on the right side and keep receipts.
Hey. Found that photo from East Ave, summer 2020. You are holding my glasses like evidence and I look like I lost a fight with an onion.
Your eyes were not accepting the evening's choices. I still have the little bottle of rinse in that folder.
Naturally you archived the rinse bottle. Also, Derek asked if you want the Roc/ACTS receipt template he uses.
Yes. I am trying to keep the four recurring ones tidy before taxes make me hate spreadsheets.
I can grab the window table if you are still aiming for 8:30.
Yes. I will bring the model notes and the Keller notebook, mostly for moral intimidation.
Excellent. The notebook has survived worse rooms than Joe Bean. Noted.
Leaving now. University is clear for once.
Joe Bean first or are you doing the towpath loop before coffee?
Loop first. I want one clean pass from Genesee Valley to Lock 32 before the path gets crowded.
Send the split after. Last week's screenshot had you annoyed at twelve seconds, which was very you.
Watch says 60 sitting still, so no excuses. I'll be at the back table by 10:05.
I got the corner table. Also, your Tuesday/Saturday streak sheet is still making my inner analyst happy.
Do not encourage the spreadsheet-adjacent behavior. I already did the morning number before leaving.
Noted. Then you are allowed one coffee and zero more tabs before methodology edits.
Too late, the Notion page has filters now.
Saw the D&C piece on Arroyo. The numbers in that school board race are tiny enough that a normal-person check actually moves.
I have the back table at Joe Bean. Did you bring the revised charts or only your thousand-yard stare?
Charts, laptop, charger, three pens. Forgot the muffin part of the plan.
Exactly. I put $500 there last time and it felt less performative than every national receipt I used to file.
I ordered you toast. We are not letting methodology revisions run the entire operating system. Noted.
Noted. Also, do not let the county slate bully you into rewarding their least awake candidate again.
I have a long memory and a very sharp pen for that little oval.
Found the old photo of you looking frozen outside that little Keene Valley place with the green door. Were you actually smiling or was that windburn?
Both. That was the trip where the stove smoked all night and I still came home convinced I needed a better route card for Marcy.
Naturally your takeaway was paperwork for a mountain. I can mail the photo if you want it for the binder.
Yes, please. The binder is getting tabs now, which is either maturity or a warning sign.
Mom asked whether your March bills got weird too. Hers jumped and she is blaming the furnace.
Mine is up, but part of that is the little voluntary line I keep refusing to uncheck.
Of course you do. Same man who has let that mountain-lion calendar arrive every December since the Bush administration.
It is a perfectly useful calendar, and the check cleared on the 1st.
Were you awake at your usual time? I did not hear from you before Mass.
Up at 6:30. Bell, 20, coffee, cat. I just forgot to text.
Good. I worry when the morning order changes.
Order intact. Sunday dinner still 5 so I can make the 7 p.m. game.
I moved Sunday dinner to 5:00. Please bring the club soda you like.
Done. I am skipping the three-finger glass until after I am home, so stop drafting the lecture.
I am your mother; drafts are permanent. Also I found two mint cartridges in the blue bowl from that awful 2022 stretch and threw them away.
Thank you. If you see the little white bottle by my sink Sunday, ignore it; it is for lights-out math, not dinner.
hey you. kiln shelf survived. one of the little red bowls did the thing you sketched, all those dots crowding the rim.
That is exactly the too-muchness I was hoping for. Can I see it after your afternoon group at MAG?
yes. 4:45 works if you do not mind clay dust and seven half-finished mugs staring at us.
I met you surrounded by stranger objects than that, so mugs are fine.
hey you. i walked past the Anderson Ave unit after kiln drop-off. north windows are good. weird freight door.
That's the one on my short list with the Gregory Street place. I'm still trying to picture benches, classroom corner, and 300 lockers without it feeling like a storage facility.
if you build the dues ladder into the first sketch, it will change the room. not just the spreadsheet.
Agreed. I moved another $400 into the separate bucket this morning, then immediately opened the old restricted-gift notes like a very fun Sunday goblin.
You are moving like yesterday was ambitious.
Tom set a pace like he was being chased. Rashida somehow looked fresh by the last staircase.
Noted. So April's route should be selected by someone with knees.
I get one veto after Watkins. That is now written law.
Derek says Thursday is still fine if you come straight from Atlantic. He is testing the rye version again.
Tell him I will grade fairly but with Monroe County standards in mind.
Bold, considering you once called orange peel 'decorative bark.' Also bring the QuickBooks printout if you can.
Printout, yes. Bark slander, noted for the warmup circle.
Catherine says Jasper's debate schedule is impossible in July. She sent me three possible weekends.
Send them along. I was already comparing ROC to DEN and pretending the seat map is a neutral object.
Please choose an aisle this time. You looked less gray when you did that.
Aisle, noise-canceling headphones, no tiny paper pharmacy bag. Same stubborn plan as last year.
Nora wants to know if the chocolate things from Christmas can be mailed or if that was a one-night miracle.
The Sichuan peppercorns survived the cabinet purge, so probably. I need cream and better chocolate first.
Please label the box this time. Jasper thought the tingle was a prank.
Fair. I am making the ginger-turmeric cup now and adding 'not a prank' to the mailing label.
The sun is actually out. Please do not waste it inside with that computer.
Already opened the blinds and fed Fermi. I will walk after I clear one invoice.
Good. Also, my driveway still has the icy ridge from yesterday.
I'll come by after lunch. This is why I cannot just become a Pittsburgh person.
Catherine asked me to send you the school board article, but the blue app on my phone says your name is not coming up anymore.
Your enrollment card came in the mail here by mistake. It still has the same checked line you picked when you first turned eighteen.
Text me the link or email it. That account has been a locked drawer for a while.
Can you put it by the pot roast coupons? I will grab it Sunday.
I also saved the city council flyer. The woman from Goodman Street called twice and sounded very organized.
All right. I am glad you are drawing instead. Did your little pause-before-opening thing work today?
It did. I got nudged out after one short pass and used the extra hour on hands, which remain rude.
She is on my $250 list if her filing goes through.
Are you still coming by before rehearsal? I saved you soup in the blue container.
Still in the studio with the projection cue sheet. I looked up and it was somehow six.
Then I am putting the soup by the door. Take it with you and use a spoon, please.
Fair. Grabbing it on the way to MuCCC.
hey you. towpath walk tonight or are your legs reserved for the park thing?
Park thing. South Wedge at 6:30 if the rain holds. I already packed the flat cones and both shirts.
then save the towpath for saturday. i can be slow company after your people try to make you shave seconds off whatever route you keep screenshotting.
Deal. If I can still throw after Tuesday's dive, I can manage a slow walk.
hey you. left the black folding pair on top of your synth instead of in the kitchen.
That object now migrates like it pays rent.
you did use it to read the tiny glaze percentages, so it earned the trip.
Please do not tell the younger version of me. He was insufferable enough.
Can you sanity-check the March sheet before rehearsal? I need to know if the new mic cable came out of tech or general.
Tech. I also split the Browncroft door deposit from the workshop deposit so the totals do not look inflated.
Bless you. Also, can your weird little laptop rig do a 3-second sheep noise on command, or is that asking too much? 🤔
It can do a sheep that gradually becomes a fax machine. Three seconds is negotiable.
Hey. Are you doing Thursday rehearsal standing, sitting, or mysterious third option?
Sitting for warmups. I had Wei last week, so I'm better, but I'm not tempting the mountain-gods of 2021.
Noted for blocking: no sudden floor work, no heroic chair collapse, no "I am fine" monologue.
Cruel but accurate. I can still do treasurer notes and heckle you professionally.
Are you still doing the Priya table thing before rehearsal week planning?
Saturday, yes. She has an RIT thing first, then we are doing my charts over coffee.
Good. Nobody sharpens your charts like the old Keller crew.
Cruel but fair. I will be properly annotated before you see me.
Hey. You missed the pre-rehearsal text three mornings in a row, which is not very you.
Yeah. I let the 6:30 block slide while finishing the figures. Fourth day is where the wheels start wobbling.
Then protect tomorrow morning like it is a paid gig. Also: Thursday rehearsal still 7.
Already put the phone across the room and queued the 20. I will be human by rehearsal.
Treasurer question: can the troupe reimburse you Friday, or does that collide with your carefully choreographed grown-up spreadsheet?
Friday is fine. The work deposit already hit at 2,800-ish, and the little Vanguard/Ally bits do their thing later.
The Virginia 401(k) alternate universe is polishing a boat right now and judging us.
That universe also has khakis with pleats. I will take my weird rollover paperwork and dignity.
Hey. You got quiet after rehearsal when Priya mentioned salary ranges.
I had a ten-minute tab-open spiral. Reston sites, old keywords, the whole ugly muscle memory.
Post-rehearsal garbage plate, or are you doing the spreadsheet-of-virtue thing tonight?
Spreadsheet wins. I have lentils at home and a fridge full of greens because apparently I am someone's responsible uncle now.
The Virginia 401(k) alternate universe is not invited to tomorrow's diner breakfast.
Fair. I will bring the museum sketchbook instead of pretending I miss forecast decks and queue charts.
The alternate-universe Virginia 401(k) Julio would have bought curly fries for the table.
Current-universe Julio spent $418 on food by March 12 and still has to save cash for the tomato guy when Brighton starts up.
You still walking home after rehearsal or should Derek and I swing you by Elmwood?
Walking. Headphones already on. I have to pass the Presbyterian driveway anyway to see if they put tomorrow's signs up.
Of course you do. Civic Batman, but with worse shoes.
Home. Shoes offended. Side latch clicked before the kettle, since apparently I am trainable.
Your square-grid thing just crossed 806 people, unless I am reading the little dashboard wrong.
You are reading it right. The Canandaigua fog frame did better than the one with the red ridge, somehow.
Because the fog one has airport-record patience. I mean that as a compliment, professor.
That is exactly the patience I was stealing. The rack behaved for once, too.
I looked at your sheet. The $3,400 line is fine, but do not bury the county payment inside repairs again.
Noted. Separate column now: regular month, house chaos, and the big March line.
Also, if you are using the $310K number for planning, mark the source and date. Future-you will forget.
Done. I also added a colder number in case I ever need it gone fast, but I hate that row.
Coffee Saturday still works. I am bringing the NYT piece, but the claim graph looked too tidy.
I read the new methods paragraph. The evaluator will not know what a Hilbert space is unless you give them a handrail.
Send it. I want to see whether Helen Branswell or Ed Yong touched the same data before I forward anything to Mom.
Noted. I can add the classroom demo language from the county version.
Noted. Also, your October CVS habit is making me feel personally disorganized.
Yes. Also keep the February letter out of your head while revising. The page budget is fixable.
I will bring the marked pages to Joe Bean Saturday. The two-slit sequence is where the numbers and drawings finally meet.
The trick is letting the calendar boss me around before Fringe eats the month.
Mom mailed me the envelope of passes and tiny maps. There is one of you making a tragic face in front of the old cameras.
Please do not show Jasper. He already has too much leverage from the miniature Wegmans photo.
Too late. Also, are you still doing the Gibbs Street thing tomorrow or should I call during your usual afternoon wandering?
Call after 4. I am going to duck into the organ studio program if the doors are open.
I found the envelope from Dr. Kaplan when I was sorting the mail pile on your table. It says $1,800 circled in red.
Please do not stage an intervention with my mail.
I am not staging anything. I just do not like that you keep moving it while that insurance payment went up again.
The new notice says fourteen percent, which is apparently a number they can just type at me.
Are you bringing Ellery on Sunday, or should I wrap the extra carrots separately again?
Maybe. They have a MAG class that runs late, so I said no pressure.
That is fine. I also found the scarf with all the red circles. It made me think of those drawings you keep doing.
Do not let the scarf near the pot roast. The circles are already taking over the sketchbook.
hey you. i left the blue mug by the sink.
Found it. Also remembered the second number before I brushed my teeth, which feels like personal growth.
the little evening ritual with the tiny scale?
Exactly. The 2026 page is now less patchy than February.
Are you doing the ice thing tonight or are you available to look at the QuickBooks weirdness before rehearsal notes bury me?
Ice thing. Declan is already texting like he personally sharpened their skates.
Of course he is. Same energy as when he explained copper fittings to me for twenty minutes at your birthday.
Siobhan just replied with a triage-desk meme, so the family group chat has reached full volume.
I asked Lina at the arts council about your draft. She said your board packet should lead with the Form 1023 timeline, then the room-use model.
That tracks. I have the board roles, the 300-person ceiling, and the pay-what-fits bands in one doc. The IRS sequence is the part I keep side-eyeing.
Use the worksheets from that online thing you finished in November. The cash reserve page was better than half the consultant decks I see.
I can bring the packet Thursday after rehearsal. Also, please stop making me look competent in front of arts administrators.
I read the draft. Cut the third paragraph. It sounds like you are mad at every server farm in Oregon.
Noted. I am only mad at the business model that turns Jasper's attention span into quarterly revenue.
Keep the warrant line, though. It is the clearest sentence in the whole thing.
Good. I want the room to hear that a school contract is not a blank check for every click and location ping.
D&C has a piece this morning on the Prude settlement follow-up. I assume you already read it over coffee.
Yes. It put me right back on East Ave with Marcus yelling that he could not see.
Noted. Also, the South Wedge fridge group sent March numbers. Your monthly transfer landed.
Good. I still need to check whether the legal-support one pulled on the 10th.
I found the postcard you sent me with the room that looked like moving rain on all four walls.
That was a good trip. I still owe you the photo of the Maine booth where the woman was carving spoons with a foot pedal.
Please send it. Also, are you really pricing a flight that goes through Tokyo?
Only pricing. The cafe bookmarks and the dust-mask spreadsheet are currently just fantasy accounting.
I put your father's 2019 Mass card on the kitchen table by accident. I will move it before dinner.
You don't have to hide it. Just maybe not next to the pot roast platter.
Fair. Dana's birthday is on my parish calendar for Tuesday. Do you still send the little note?
Yes. Short and decent. If she mentions Miriam, I'll probably read that part twice.
I put the framed picture from your father's desk aside. Would it fit on the small wall in the room with all the screens?
Maybe above the tablet arm. That room is tight, but the cape gives me just enough wall if I move the little rack.
Please do not drill into plaster before dinner. Also send me a new picture of Fermi on the stairs.
No drilling before pot roast. Stair photo coming if she stops judging the tape measure.
I put the roast in too early. It may be dry by five.
Then it will be exactly as tradition demands.
Very funny. Please come a little before five if you want to clear the strip by the garage.
Leaving Brighton at 4:35, so I should be there with time to offend you in person.
I put the mail on your kitchen chair. There is another glossy envelope with a bear on it.
Thanks. That one can go by the bill folder. I need the member number off it.
Also your electric paper says you are paying extra again. I am not scolding, just reporting.
Leave it in the folder too. I check both before Sunday dinner so I do not forget.
Father Tom said there will be a voter table after Mass. I took two flyers for you because they mentioned hospital bills and safe storage.
Bring them to dinner. I want to see if the hospital piece is the real all-in public card or just another coupon maze.
One flyer also says sales should have the same screening whether it is a store or a private person. That seems sensible to me.
That is the part I keep underlining. The scary-looking-rifle fight is where campaigns go to burn six months.
hey you. the map on your kitchen table has colored dots all over it now.
I started marking the ones I can do as day starts from Heart Lake versus the ones that need the woodstove-and-outhouse kind of weekend.
the little red notebook is from before?
Yeah. Old mileage notes, bad coffee notes, one very dramatic page about rain on the roof near Elk Lake Road.
Ayo says if you come the second weekend, he can grab you from the airport before Nora's rehearsal pickup.
That weekend may work. I need the gentlest itinerary known to modern aviation.
Book the earlier nonstop, aisle seat, and do the headphone ritual. You know the drill.
I know. And no, I am still not asking Dr. K for the little backup bottle.
Should I move pot roast earlier on the 22nd? I wrote down that you have the children on the computer that night.
Yes please. If we eat at 5, I can be home and set up by 6:45.
That is fine. I will tell Catherine not to call during your three hours.
Thanks. I still have to finish the stat sheets before then, so earlier dinner helps.
Joe Bean at 8:30 still works. I saved the back table.
Yes. I need ten minutes after Walgreens because the refill line opens at 8 and I forgot to grab it yesterday.
Fine. Bring the orange bottle and your Mellon figures. Also: Dr. Liu day yesterday, correct?
Correct. Figures are coming too. My calendar now looks like it was assembled by a very stern nurse.
Before I put Rocky Mountain plans in the July spreadsheet: are you cleared for actual trail miles this year?
Let's keep it gentle. March has been one of the two annual reminders that I am not nineteen.
Flat route near Bear Lake, then. Also, schedule the South Wedge person before you fly, please.
Already penciled for early June with Wei. I accept older-sister administration.
Do you want me to save the small cardboard tubes from the paper towels? I remember you needed those for the children at the library.
Yes, please. They become cheap spectroscopes if I bring enough tape.
I put them in the front closet. Are you at the museum again Tuesday and Thursday this week?
Tuesday morning and Thursday afternoon, four hours each. Jenna moved the Thursday room, so I need to check the email before I drive over.
hey you. kiln opened clean. i can send photos here, unless you want them in the old album place.
Here is better. I have not posted there since 2020, and logging in feels like opening a basement freezer.
here, then. also the moving dots from your sketch looked like thrown slip.
That one is p5.js talking to a Max patch badly. I will clean it up after my feed timer stops treating me like a toddler.
Hey. I moved the first pass of the September order to our shared folder. Nine years and you still alphabetize the bits like a librarian.
Nine years and you still name files like a haunted fax machine.
Fair. Thursday can we try your diner scene before the closer? It has the right bad-coffee energy.
Yes, but only if you stop making me enter cash receipts at 10:07 p.m.
Sunday after the 5-ish Eleanor circuit, are you still making the 7 D&D start?
Yes. Pittsford loop, plate, driveway edge if needed, then home. The timing is weirdly engineered now.
A full domestic obstacle course before wizard paperwork. Respect.
It is not a loop if she sends me back for the leftovers I forgot.
I am taking the back table at Joe Bean. Do you want the usual mug or are you already over-caffeinated?
No coffee yet. I brought the thermos with the orange stuff and two containers: duck slices plus cherries/balsamic in the tiny jar.
Noted. Please do not let the tiny jar leak onto my methodology edits.
I wrapped it like lab glass. Also tucked in mint because the sauce got a little smug overnight.
Mom says you enlarged the restaurant menu photo on your phone and then blamed the lighting.
The lighting was committing crimes.
Sure. Add another pair to the car before you make Nora read you the D&D spell text over Zoom.
A devastating but administratively useful suggestion.
I mailed Mom the envelope you left here last Christmas. It had the Midtown ticket stub, two tiny Maine vendor stickers, and a coffee shop list in Japanese.
